generated_for: Linden Surfboards official named model catalog

brands.name: Linden Surfboards
brands.short_description: Linden Surfboards has been shaped by hand in Oceanside, CA since 1978. Gary Linden shapes custom foam, balsa, and agave boards from his Oceanside workshop.

models.name: Todos
models.description: Big wave gun built for 30-foot-plus offshore reef breaks. Available 9–10'6" in polyurethane or agave. Shaped to order by Gary Linden. Available dimensions: 9'0" x 20 1/4" x 3 1/8"; 9'6" x 20 1/2" x 3 1/4"; 10' x 21" x 3 1/2"; 10'6" x 21 1/2" x 3 3/4".

models.name: Catalina
models.description: The Catalina is a mid-length shape running 6'8" to 7'0". It's built for point breaks and slower, more drawn-out surf. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 6'8" x 19 3/4" x 2 1/2"; 7'0" x 20" x 2 3/4".

models.name: Model S
models.description: The Model S is Gary's all-around shortboard, available from 5'8" to 6'2". It works in most conditions and is the most versatile shape in the lineup. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 5'8" x 18 1/2" x 2 1/4"; 5'10" x 18 3/4" x 2 3/8"; 6'0" x 19" x 2 1/2"; 6'2" x 19 1/4" x 2 1/2".

models.name: Nub
models.description: The Nub is a wide, short board built for small, weak surf. Runs 5'6" to 6'6" with extra width for paddle power in flat conditions. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 5'6" x 21" x 2 1/2"; 6'0" x 21 1/2" x 2 3/4"; 6'6" x 22" x 2 3/4".

models.name: Chips and Salsa
models.description: The Chips and Salsa is a classic longboard shape running 9'0" to 9'6". Built for smooth, cross-stepping surf. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 9'0" x 22 1/4" x 2 3/4"; 9'6" x 22 1/2" x 3".

models.name: Oaxaca
models.description: The Oaxaca is a step-up shape running 8'0" to 8'4", built for larger surf where a standard shortboard loses drive. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 8'0" x 20" x 3"; 8'4" x 20 1/4" x 3 1/8".

models.name: Saqua
models.description: The Saqua is a fish shape running 6'2" to 6'6". Wide tail, low rocker, built for small to medium surf. Available in polyurethane or agave. Available dimensions: 6'2" x 19" x 2 1/2"; 6'6" x 19 1/4" x 2 5/8".
